input: Fresh temporary Playwright browser; real pointer/keyboard and public wheel. No injected application state or document.
nativeDpiPolicy: GetDpiForWindow returned 110 DPI, not 110 percent. Native client pixels are retained without resampling. Browser candidates use DPR 1 and 100 percent zoom. Full DPR-1 native parity is not accepted from these captures.

comparisons.note: The native preview shows diameter 10. The next real radius click is 6 with snap disabled, followed by the driving diameter 12 command.

comparisons.paletteState: nonempty under-constrained sketch; empty-palette height is intentionally not used

comparisons.cameraBehavior: The real normal-view action was invoked. Its fit/center differences remain in measurements; no state or camera was injected to conceal them.

comparisons.extrusion: Not run in the visual capture scenario; covered by the functional workspace E2E.

responsive.limitation: Fusion enforced a 1375-pixel minimum client width at its current DPI; this is not a 1366-pixel native capture.

comparisonPolicy: MATCHES_REFERENCE_CLIENT_PX means only measured client-pixel bounds fit the stated tolerance. DIFF records a measurable difference. Neither result accepts raster/icon parity, semantic equivalence or owner visual acceptance.

cameraCalibration.method: public mouse wheel at rendered world origin
